purpose: Document independent city-specific registry discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access investigation.
assessment: Fresh English and Chinese searches found official Xinjiang Natural Resources reporting that the Changji prefecture unified real-estate registration platform covers Changji City and stores GIS spatial information. Official pages did not yield a public viewer/API with anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry output, so no GeoJSON was retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry custody is evidenced, so registryFound is true. The official report names the prefecture/city natural-resources registration system and explicitly states coverage of all county/city systems, including Changji City. Geometry access and runtime qualification remain held.

geometryDecision.details: No anonymous safe parcel geometry response with stable native identity, schema, and CRS was found; no GeoJSON retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official reporting claims unified platform coverage across Changji prefecture county/city systems, including Changji City, with GIS spatial data.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Registry/platform existence and claimed Changji City coverage verified, but open parcel query coverage, schema, CRS, and geometry access were not verified.

remainingUncertainty: Authenticated or browser-mediated access may expose safe parcel geometry; exact-point querying was not attempted because no anonymous usable feature request was identified.
